Sam — thanks for the clear ask. Proposed plan below (high level) and we can iterate: 

Proposed maintenance window: 2025-10-15 02:00–06:00 UTC (4h) — early-morning UTC to reduce BAU impact.

High-level flow:
1) Preflight rehearsal (dry run) 3 days before window — canary group + smoke tests
2) On-window: drain long-running requests, KV-cache snapshot, apply pinned version to canary nodes, validate telemetry for 20m
3) Stage roll to remaining nodes in 3 waves with health gates (latency, error-rate, QPS)
4) Abort criteria and automated rollback: if gate fails twice consecutively within 10m, trigger reversion to pinned image and re-open peering as needed

I will coordinate the dry-run scheduling. Neha — can you attach a concise version-gate checklist we can use for the compliance sign-off? Laura — please propose owner assignments for network and DB role (BGP/peering rollback owner).

Sam — confirm the window above or suggest alternate UTC times and whether NetOps needs a separate maintenance window for peering changes.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Version gate playbook & ops assignments — technical checklist and gating thresholds

Attaching a trimmed version-gate checklist for sign-off (version_gate_checklist.pdf) and the network diagram that maps peering and NAT egress (network-diagram.vsdx). Below are the gating thresholds we intend to enforce during rollout: 

Preflight checks (dry run):
- Sanity: smoke test pass rate >= 99% after canary install
- Latency: p95 tail increase <= 10% against baseline
- Error rate: API 5xx <= 0.5%

Canary gating (live window):
- Gate window: monitor 20 minutes after canary flip; if any metric crosses threshold twice within that window, halt and roll back canary
- Roll decision matrix: after successful canary, we advance to wave 1 (25%), wave 2 (50%), wave 3 (25%) with 15 minute observation windows per wave

Rollback mechanics (short):
- Reversion time target: full re-image of a node and re-join to fleet < 12 minutes; for critical node types target < 5 minutes via pre-baked pinned snapshot
- Network rollback: NetOps to re-enable previous peering policy and BGP announcements within 5 minutes of rollback trigger; documented runbook step exists in network-diagram.vsdx

Telemetry & runbooks:
- Dashboards: pinned 'ACME Private Upgrade' dashboard — health, request latency, tail, error-rate, and circuit-breaker tripped metrics
- Alerting: immediate slack paging to #acme-upgrade and phone pagers if gate fails

Please review the checklist and backchannel any stricter thresholds required by compliance.

Neha Kapoor
Manager, Deployment Reliability — Redwood Inference
